title: A line with only a tab after the content of a block scalar is not content
notes: The content indentation is set by the first non-empty line, here ` a` (one space). The next line has no leading space, so it is less indented than the content, it ends the scalar, and a line of only white space after the end of the node is a comment line (production 78) with nothing to say. Compare yaml-test-suite Y79Y/000, where the tab-only line is the first non-empty line of the scalar: it has no leading spaces, so no content indentation of at least one can be detected, and the input is an error. The kit reads both the same way: a tab never counts as indentation, and a line that holds only a tab is content only where indentation is already set and the line is indented at least that far (Y79Y/001 has the tab after one space). DK95/04 shows the tab-only line is white space between entries.

provenance.reference: A reader that rejected a final line of only a tab after a block scalar, at the end of the input.
